Discount Pool Repair And Renovation Closed · Opens 9 AM Thu · (817) 689-1810

We had a fantastic experience with Discount Pools when Tony replaced our sand filter. From start to finish, he was professional, quick to respond, and incredibly knowledgeable. He always took the time to offer options when available, which we really appreciated. It’s clear he’s trustworthy and takes pride in his work — everything was done efficiently, thoroughly, and he left the area spotless.  We wouldn’t hesitate to call him again and highly recommend him to anyone needing pool work done right.
reviews.author: Vicky VanGo

reviews.text: Discount Pool Repair & Renovation did an outstanding job fixing my pool pump gasket today! The team was professional, prompt, and highly skilled. They quickly diagnosed the issue and had it repaired in no time, ensuring my pool was back up and running perfectly. Their service was top-notch, and I highly recommend them to anyone in Arlington, TX, needing reliable pool repairs. Thank you for the great work!
reviews.author: Shane Vick

reviews.text: I had a very positive experience with my pool replastering job. What started out as what we had hoped to be a small project turned into a much larger one. It turns out that the previous owners had unsatisfactory work done on this pool. They had multiple layers of plaster put on and that needed to be removed and redone properly. Once It was discovered and explained to us what our choices were, we agreed to have it done correctly. His team was very professional and timely in the process of completion. I couldn’t be more happy with the way this pool turned out and highly recommend their company services.
reviews.author: Steve Jones

reviews.text: Discount Pool has been my go to for all pool repairs, maintenance and more!  They resurfaced our pool recently and it turned out great.  The team was very professional, the work was done timely and cleaned up after they were finished!  They have also helped me w our pool sweep and pump motor!  You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: Kassy Tanner

reviews.text: I don't usually do reviews, but Tony deserves to be recognized. He is very responsive and knowledgeable. He advised me on what was needed and took time to explain everything. I will definitely be using his services in the future.
reviews.author: Michael Meyer

reviews.text:
Tony with Discount Pools Repairs and Renovations was very knowledgeable, professional, but more importantly friendly. The work was completed on time and all questions answered patiently. We had all tile in the pool and hot tub replaced as well as complete resurfacing on both. They were less expensive than the other 2 quotes, yet we received excellent work by his crew. We had one issue that Tony came out to inspect and he had it fixed THAT DAY! I do highly recommend this company with any of your pool renovations.
Dave
reviews.author: David Lyons

reviews.text: Tony has done work on my pool 3 different times and I have nothing but gratitude for him. His prices are great, his work is impeccable and above all his customer service is above the 5 stars allowed here
reviews.author: Voko Liboma

reviews.text: This pool service is great. They are very down to earth and honest. The work is exceptional and they are very neat and tidy on the clean up.  They gave a cost that was affordable and just did a great job. I'm keeping them on my list! I will recommend them to all my friends.
reviews.author: Tommy
